could_not_do: No live browser perturb-and-observe was run for the top-10 ranked findings. node tools/contention.mjs --gate reported 8 browser instances against a ceiling of 6 at the time it was needed (RULES.md rule 21). Substituted static source-to-sink tracing (read the actual consuming function, confirmed it never references the field, and in two cases found the parallel hard-coded logic that stands in instead) rather than a bare grep-and-call-it-verified. Findings marked STATIC-TRACE in the report still need a browser confirmation before repair effort is spent.

648 name-grep orphan candidates (of 2,482 fields scanned) were not individually traced end-to-end; only ~40 were hand-verified. The report ranks the traced subset and lists the rest as available via --json rather than guessing at their status.

camera (100), stealth (96) and crime (105) orphan-candidate buckets are flagged UNRESOLVED-AGGREGATE rather than classified: a sample check found these directories mix real gameplay fields with embedded calibration/acceptance-criteria documents (e.g. game/data/camera/reference-framing.json, fetched at boot per game/data/index.json but never parsed at runtime — its conclusions are hand-transcribed into source comments instead) that are legitimately consumed only by critic tooling. Mass-labelling these 301 fields as orphan without checking which is which would itself be a wrong-CONSUMED-shaped mistake at scale.

The fourth baseline finding named in the dispatch brief (a fog-thins-with-altitude setting) could not be re-located under any of the field-name variants tried (fog+altitude, fogAltitude, fog_thin). Reported UNRESOLVED rather than guessed fixed or still-broken; needs the original finder's exact field name to re-check honestly.

userData.surfaceUniforms (baseline finding #1) was re-checked only at the mechanism level (confirmed installSurfaceShader() installs userData.surfaceUniforms together with onBeforeCompile at the same call site, so the direct path is genuinely consumed) — the actual defect is in Material.copy()-derived clones across 406 materials, which needs a clone-lineage walk this census pass did not attempt.
